title: narcissus caucasicus
intro: Narcissus caucasicus, commonly known as the Caucasian daffodil or Poet's narcissus, is a species of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its bulbous roots and trumpet-shaped flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Narcissus caucasicus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as galantamine, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions including neuroprotective, anti-anxiety, and anti-convulsant effects.
